newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: CONSENSUS-Reuters survey of NZ economic forecasts.
newsitem.headline: CONSENSUS-Reuters survey of NZ economic forecasts.

text.p: The following New Zealand economic indicators are scheduled for this week. Times are GMT.
Please note the addition of forecasts from WestpacTrust, which have changed the averages and medians from those previously published.
DAY TIME INDICATOR PERIOD AVG F/CAST PREVIOUS
Tue 2245 d Retail trade April +1.38 pct -3.9 pct
e Retail trade Yr to April -3.66 pct -4.8 pct
FORECAST NO OF RESPONDENTS MEDIAN RANGE

Respondents to the survey were: AMP Investments (NZ) Ltd, ANZ Bank, ASB Bank, Bancorp Merchant Bank, Bankers Trust NZ, Deutsche Morgan Grenfell, First NZ Capital, Garlick and Co, National Bank of New Zealand, SBC Warburg, WestpacTrust.
